#{plotId}, #{userId}, #{deviceCode}, #{name}, #{typeId}, #{controlStatus}, #{onlineStatus}, #{healthStatus}, #{installTime}, #{offlineTime}, #{faultTime}, #{lastHeartbeatTime}, #{lastOnlineTime}, #{onlineDuration}, #{lastDataTime}, #{location},
mapper.update:
UPDATE `iot_device`
plot_id = #{plotId}, user_id = #{userId}, device_code = #{deviceCode}, name = #{name}, type_id = #{typeId}, control_status = #{controlStatus},
online_status = #{onlineStatus}, offline_time = CASE WHEN #{onlineStatus} = 0 THEN COALESCE(offline_time, NOW()) ELSE NULL END, last_online_time = CASE WHEN #{onlineStatus} = 1 THEN COALESCE(last_online_time, NOW()) ELSE last_online_time END,
health_status = #{healthStatus}, fault_time = CASE WHEN #{healthStatus} IN (1, 2) THEN COALESCE(fault_time, NOW()) ELSE NULL END,
install_time = #{installTime}, last_heartbeat_time = #{lastHeartbeatTime}, last_online_time = #{lastOnlineTime}, online_duration = #{onlineDuration}, last_data_time = #{lastDataTime}, location = #{location},
WHERE id = #{id}

UPDATE `iot_device` SET online_duration = CASE WHEN #{onlineStatus} = 0 THEN GREATEST(TIMESTAMPDIFF(SECOND, COALESCE(install_time, create_time, NOW()), NOW()), 0) ELSE online_duration END, offline_time = CASE WHEN #{onlineStatus} = 0 THEN NOW() ELSE NULL END, last_online_time = CASE WHEN #{onlineStatus} = 1 AND (online_status != 1 OR last_online_time IS NULL) THEN NOW() WHEN #{onlineStatus} = 0 THEN NULL ELSE last_online_time END, online_status = #{onlineStatus} WHERE id = #{id}

UPDATE `iot_device` SET health_status = #{healthStatus}, control_status = CASE WHEN #{healthStatus} IN (1, 2) THEN 0 ELSE control_status END, online_status = CASE WHEN #{healthStatus} IN (1, 2) THEN 0 ELSE online_status END, offline_time = CASE WHEN #{healthStatus} IN (1, 2) THEN COALESCE(offline_time, NOW()) ELSE offline_time END, fault_time = CASE WHEN #{healthStatus} IN (1, 2) THEN NOW() ELSE NULL END WHERE id = #{id}

UPDATE `iot_device` SET last_heartbeat_time = #{lastHeartbeatTime}, last_online_time = CASE WHEN online_status != 1 OR last_online_time IS NULL THEN #{lastHeartbeatTime} ELSE last_online_time END, offline_time = NULL, online_status = 1 WHERE id = #{id}

UPDATE `iot_device` d SET d.health_status = 0, d.online_status = 1, d.offline_time = NULL, d.fault_time = NULL, d.last_online_time = NOW() WHERE d.id = #{id} AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM `iot_device_fault` f WHERE f.device_id = d.id AND f.status IN (0, 1) AND f.is_deleted = 0 )
